patterns: Direct one-liners: seat of the Peshwas (Poona), Panipat III opponents (Marathas vs Abdali), date 1761, chronicler Kashiraj Pandit.
Chronology of Peshwas (Balaji Vishwanath > Baji Rao I > Balaji Baji Rao > Madhav Rao I) is a recurring ordering item.
Treaty-pair items: Mungi-Shevgaon = Marathas-Nizam (APPSC 2025); Salbai ends First War; Bassein 1802.
Traps: when the Peshwa became virtual ruler (Balaji Bajirao, not Balaji Vishwanath); Pindaris = Maratha horsemen.
App leans on multi-statement UPSC-style items; APPSC asks mostly single-fact MCQs.
